Scenario fixture: aria-role-name-present

Covers roles: scrollbar, toolbar, tablist, radiogroup, tree, grid, menu, menubar, meter, progressbar. Allowed name sources: aria-label, aria-labelledby, title — subtree content is NOT a valid name source for these roles. Each target has a stable id role_case_NN.

A. One role per allowlisted role: baseline pass/fail

01 — FAIL: role=scrollbar, no name
02 — PASS: role=scrollbar, aria-label
03 — FAIL: role=toolbar, no name
04 — PASS: role=toolbar, aria-labelledby
Editor tools
05 — FAIL: role=tablist, no name
06 — PASS: role=tablist, title
07 — FAIL: role=radiogroup, no name (even though content has text)
Contact method
08 — PASS: role=radiogroup, aria-label
09 — FAIL: role=tree, no name (even though items have text)
Documents
10 — PASS: role=tree, aria-label
Documents
11 — FAIL: role=grid, no name
12 — PASS: role=grid, aria-label
13 — FAIL: role=menu, no name
14 — PASS: role=menu, aria-label
15 — FAIL: role=menubar, no name
16 — PASS: role=menubar, aria-label
17 — FAIL: role=meter, no name
18 — PASS: role=meter, aria-label
19 — FAIL: role=progressbar, no name
20 — PASS: role=progressbar, title

B. aria-labelledby referencing a hidden node still counts (spec-conformant)

21 — PASS: role=scrollbar, aria-labelledby references aria-hidden node (still counts as name text per spec)
Scroll

C. Empty/whitespace attribute edge cases

22 — FAIL: role=radiogroup, whitespace-only aria-label
23 — FAIL: role=grid, aria-labelledby references non-existent id

D. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

24 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: role=toolbar, aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
25 — EXCEPTION: role=toolbar, aria-hidden="true" but focusable (tabindex=0) => eligible, missing name => FAIL

E. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

26 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
27 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
28 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
29 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

F. Inertness (ineligible)

30 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
31 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

End of fixture.
